newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products dip, fuel oil by most.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products dip, fuel oil by most.

text.p: NWE oil products dipped on Thursday, fuel oil by almost $2 a tonne, dealers said.
Heating oil barges softened as IPE futures came off slightly. Buyers, hoping for further weakness, held off, while sellers appeared to hold more strictly to their offers of IPE May +$1 fob ARA.

High sulphur fuel oil barges were discussed at $80/$82, with bids at least $2 a tonne lower than at Wednesday's close. Some traders said the market was held up artificially on Wednesday and was now reverting to a level that reflected fundamentals. Bunker demand was again poor.
